release.name: iCTRL 1.98.16
release.body:
An AI-friendly iOS/iPadOS automation service. Tell your agent *"My iPhone is running iCTRL at :8200 — figure out how to drive it."* and it reads the on-device manual and takes it from there. Works with any agent that can make HTTP requests: OpenClaw, Hermes, Minis, Claude Code, Codex and others. ## Downloads ### Which IPA do I need? | File | Needed? | What it is | |---|---|---| | `iCTRLUITests-Runner.ipa` | **Required** | The automation engine. It serves the JSON-RPC API that agents and clients call, and must be running. | | `iCTRL.ipa` | Optional | A companion app for tasks on the phone itself:
• mount the Developer Disk Image without a Mac, and remount it after a reboot
• start and stop the runner
• choose who can reach the runner (this device only / LAN / LAN + nearby)
• see and revoke authorized clients
• read the runner's log live | Skip `iCTRL.ipa` if you mount the Developer Disk Image with Xcode or StikDebug, and manage the runner from its notification or a computer. With a free Apple ID you get three sideloaded apps, and SideStore uses one of them. Install StikDebug *or* the iCTRL app alongside the runner, not both. Both IPAs are unsigned for distribution (ad-hoc, no provisioning profile). Sign them when you install: - **Free Apple ID:** the latest SideStore signs and installs them. Older SideStore releases skip the nested `.xctest`, and the runner then crashes on launch. - **Paid account:** `Scripts/sign-ipa.sh -i iCTRLUITests-Runner.ipa` The runner also needs the Developer Disk Image mounted (Xcode, StikDebug or the iCTRL app). The [README](https://github.com/OpenMinis/iCTRL#installation) covers the whole setup. ## What's new since 1.98.15 ### Input - **Continuous single-finger drag paths.** `drag` accepts a `points` array (2-64 waypoints, 0.1-10 s) and follows it with one finger, pressing once and lifting once. Draw corners, unlock patterns, drag-to-reorder. Corners can be rounded by 1-2 pt, so keep each segment at least one frame long. Advertised as the `drag_path` capability. Existing endpoint/ref drags are unchanged. Thanks to @YanYunNN. ### Build - `make ipa UNSIGNED=1` builds release IPAs without a signing identity. ## Earlier in 1.98.13 - 1.98.15 - The video stream skips identical frames while the screen is still, and no longer goes black after the runner was in the background. - The remote page keeps FPS, quality and verbose across reloads. - `type` falls back to on-screen key taps when a field drops focus and reports failures. `keyboard.visible` detects third-party keyboards. - More methods require authorization. The iCTRL app imports RemotePairing files such as StikDebug's pairingFile.plist.

local_gaps.impact: CLI/shared request contract/local iOS Simulator host HID
local_gaps.gap: 缺少单次按下、多个拐点、末尾一次抬起的机器可读路径动作。现有直线swipe不能组合为保持接触的折线，连续多次swipe会中途抬指。
local_gaps.implementation_boundary: 独立实现host-HID路径；不复制私有XCTest、不扩embedded UIKit能力，不自动增加Android/Harmony路径或真机控制。保留Device Hub/Resize/几何拒绝及unknown不可重放。 本地已有executeNativeHIDContacts可复用事件发送与失败释放，但其统一cadence只验证直线12事件；多段独立offset、每拐点采样和hold不是已验证兼容能力。
bdd: Given 2–64 finite in-bounds points and bounded duration, When path action executes, Then one down/all waypoints/one up preserve order and repeated waypoint hold timing.
Given invalid/mixed endpoint arguments, nonfinite/out-of-bounds points or incompatible surface, When validating, Then reject before any down.
Given failure after down or surface changes, Then best-effort release at last attempted point, report unknown and never replay.
Given old tap/swipe callers, Then existing wire/geometry semantics remain unchanged.
acceptance: Red/green parsing and Codable/schema tests; fake sender proves every coordinate prevalidated and exact phase/order/timing.
Tests for geometry/Device Hub/Resize, cancellation/partial failure and release; full CLI/root/local checks as applicable.
Real isolated owned Simulator drawing/reorder fixture with event trace and postcondition is separate acceptance, requires device authorization; source review does not prove delivery.
validation_prerequisites: 先在独立可行性space用离线contract/fake sender验证绝对offset模型与向后兼容，不宣称guest收到事件。
取得专用Simulator设备验证授权后，以自有绘图fixture采集真实touchesBegan/Moved/Ended事件、单touch身份、拐角/hold/最大时长及中途失败清理。
实际触点证明/明确可支持范围齐备后再由主控裁决adopt；无设备授权先观察，不将private XCTest上游表现移植成native HID保证。

other_decisions.mechanism: typing focus loss / soft keyboard fallback
other_decisions.reason: 当前Runner公开XCUIElement.typeText前重新解析焦点，返回submitted=true/postconditionVerified=false；embedded走公开UIKeyInput，SP196 WebView有读回校验。上游虚拟硬件键盘失焦现象尚未在Triton复现，自动整段重输有重复输入风险，不据上游声明新增本地bug。屏幕键/拼音候选私有snapshot实现不直接采用。
本地FramebufferSession.processFrame已比较JPEG并只在变化时递增version，SP196生命周期/双订阅与helper取消已交付。

other_decisions.mechanism: idle thermal throttling / VideoToolbox encoder recovery
other_decisions.reason: 本地Simulator IOSurface/JPEG callbacks与CLI终端mirror不是iOS H264 VideoToolbox会话；不存在同一路径encoder黑屏证据。不以降热自述推定本地性能缺陷。
上游正式remote控制页；本地Web为mock只读展示，不增加remote Web写控制或复制browser pairing storage。
新unsigned打包针对iCTRL侧载产品，Triton CLI/SDK和显式Runner构建不同；不扩签名/DDI/配对边界。v1.98.15中安全/RemotePairing说明为旧变化，已由10月20日SP193评估和SP203–205认证/日志/发现边界处理，不重复排期。
SP192已有alias/预算/OCR/settle/UI健康与未知不重放；SP196有foreground/证据完整性；SP200已有录制/观察后动作验证；SP223输出收尾已在实际main，不作为本次新增采用。
现有发送器可接受任意NativeHIDContact列表，但public入口/模型尚无路径，uniform cadence没有每段时间模型；最小技术面是新增path DTO/CLI、offset contacts及guard复用，仍需真实guest触点验收，离线契约不能证明完成。
